message:
Hey everyone! 🕯️ So, I was thinking about those moments when the lights go out and chaos ensues. You know, that family group chat buzzing with everyone’s updates, tips, and maybe a few jokes to lighten the mood? It’s a great time to share ideas on how to make things a little easier during a blackout. 

I found this really handy resource that covers everything from food safety to keeping your devices charged. It’s nice to be prepared, so when the power goes out, it’s less about panic and more about figuring out the next fun family activity! 

What’s your go-to tip for handling a blackout? Let’s share ideas!
